queries.name: InfrastructureWorkbookRunQuery
rules: source workbook path/body/XML are not rendered as authority
technical staging rows are not exposed as mutable domain state

queries.name: InfrastructureWorkbookProposalQuery
rules: blank-preserve fields explicitly show NO_CHANGE rather than empty proposed clear
secret/topology-invalid rows never expose prohibited payload content

queries.name: InfrastructureWorkbookHistoryQuery
rules: exported file current existence is not required for retained export evidence
accepted run evidence survives staging cleanup

queries.name: InfrastructureWorkbookReplayQuery
output: accepted prior run id/date or none
rules: digest is replay identity only and no authenticity/security claim is returned

review_projection: UI review groups proposals into Create, Update, Relationship change, Unchanged, Ambiguous, Unknown reference, Invalid/Skipped and Warnings. Material relationship changes are never hidden inside a generic Updated count.
reader_contract: Stable snapshot, paginated rows, bounded impact JSON decoded through versioned closed schemas.
